'''Poppe''' is a male Light Energy Sciences student from [[New Federation]], found talking with his classmate, '''Leroiel'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Poppe:''' Have you seen that [[Skelecanth]] in the culture chambers?
:'''Poppe:''' It's exactly like the one in the Collins documentary trilogy. 
:'''Leroiel:''' You've got it backwards. The documentary was filmed based on real animals.
:'''Leroiel:''' But I get it. Seeing a fish swim through sand must be strange for anyone who didn't grow up in Lahai-Roi.
:'''Poppe:''' Tell me about it. The deserts outside the New Federation cities don't have fish like that.
:'''Poppe:''' It's crazy how much you miss when you only see something through a screen. You really have to see it in person.
:'''Poppe:''' Being able to actually see them swirl through the sand, like fish in water, must be a wonderful feeling.
{{Dialogue End}}
